title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: USA, Bangalore, Delhi
 Mode of Work: Remote
 Brief Overview of the Job Description:
 We are seeking a seasoned DevOps Engineer to join our client, a distinguished IT services and consulting firm renowned for their comprehensive approach to solving modern business challenges. The role focuses on automating and optimizing operations and development processes. This position is critical for deploying product updates, identifying production issues, and implementing integrations to meet customer needs.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Develop and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and related tools to reduce deployment costs and increase efficiency.
 Implement cost-effective cloud solutions and optimize resource utilization across AWS, Azure, and GCP platforms.
 Manage code deployments, fixes, updates, and related processes across multiple environments to ensure high availability and reliability for end-users.
 Collaborate with customer-facing teams to understand user requirements and provide technical solutions that enhance customer satisfaction.
 Oversee automated testing to ensure system reliability, scalability, and security, reducing downtime and enhancing system performance.
 Work closely with development teams to integrate new deployment processes and resolve configuration issues quickly and efficiently.
 Utilize containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes to streamline development and production environments.
 Implement robust monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and resolve production issues.
 Develop and maintain documentation for CI/CD processes, deployment guidelines, and operational procedures.
 Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to continually improve DevOps practices and processes.
 Participate in training and certification programs to enhance skills and knowledge in cloud platforms and DevOps tools.
 Mentor and train junior team members to build a strong DevOps culture within the organization.
 Engage in continuous learning opportunities to stay ahead of technological advancements and best practices.
 Technologies to be Used:
 Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Terraform
 Docker, Kubernetes
 AWS, Azure, GCP
 Python, Bash, Ansible
 Qualifications:
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
 Certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP are highly desirable.
 Certifications such as Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Jenkins, or Certified DevOps Professional are advantageous.
 Knowledge:
 Profound knowledge in cloud infrastructure, especially on platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP.
 Strong understanding of scripting and automation using tools such as Bash, Python, and Ansible.
 Skills:
 Expertise in using a wide range of cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) including setting up, configuring, and optimizing.
 Proficiency in CI/CD methodologies and tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Terraform).
 Strong command over containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
 Solid scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages.
 Familiarity with network protocols and standards, including HTTP, REST, SSL.
 Attitude:
 Problem-solving mindset with strong decision-making skills.
 Highly proactive team player with an innovative approach to technology deployment.
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
 Detail-oriented with a dedication to technical excellence and user satisfaction.
 Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and tools.
 Work Environment:
 Dynamic and collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.
 Supportive team culture that encourages knowledge sharing and professional growth.
 Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance.
 Key Performance Indicators:
 Efficiency and scalability of CI/CD pipelines.
 System reliability and uptime.
 Speed and quality of code deployments and updates.
 Customer satisfaction with deployment processes and system performance.
 Continuous improvement in automation and operational processes.
 Salary and Benefits:
 Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.
 Comprehensive health insurance, dental and vision coverage.
 Generous PTO and flexible work arrangements.
 Access to ongoing training and career advancement opportunities.
 Employee wellness and engagement programs.
 Company Overview:
 Mhymatch is hiring for a client who is a distinguished IT services and consulting firm renowned for their comprehensive approach to solving modern business challenges. Specializing in tailoring innovative IT solutions, this client leverages cutting-edge technology and deep industry expertise to empower businesses across various sectors. Their commitment to delivering exceptional strategic insights and operational excellence makes them a trusted advisor and partner in driving digital transformation and sustainable growth.
 Diversity Policy:
 Committed to a diverse work environment, we are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.
 Career Growth:
 As a rapidly growing company, we offer substantial upward mobility and opportunities for career advancement. We support continuous learning with access to training and new technologies.
 Originally posted on Himalayas
